notes.title: Overcooked! All You Can Eat's Winter Chef Update: Out Now
notes.content:
Chefs, today we have a slice of news, as we are happy to announce the [i][b]FREE Winter Chef Update![/b][/i]

[previewyoutube=5QLWyrUkxDk;full][/previewyoutube]
A blizzard has thrown a new winter Chef into the Overcooked All You Can Eat kitchens! Introducing...

[b][h2]Penguin Chef 🐧[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/5ab6e147f5aea155fedbb5caf0fee897caa5b1a0.gif[/img]

Go flippers for the latest Chef to enter Overcooked! All You Can Eat! Create some of their favourite meals... not just seafood recipes, they love ice-burgers and brrrrritos! We hope you have a blast when cooking with the all new Penguin Chef, even if they are a bit of a fishy character.

Alongside the new Penguin Chef, we have two alternate skins coming to Overcooked All You Can Eat!

[b][h2]Macaroni Penguin Skin 🍝🐧[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/a03c183604d0a8bb7f6b26db98caa010485547fd.gif[/img]

An alternate skin for our new Penguin Chef joins the chaos! Cook meals with the Macaroni Penguin Skin, hopefully with a little less fire... but hey, the fish won't cook without a few flames! Just maybe in fryer next time. We hope you think this chef is pasta-tively amazing!

[b][h2]Arctic Fox Skin ❄️🦊[/h2][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/1eb944fa84f237d8b05187f43d44a25cefbae1a9.gif[/img]

For the Winter Chef Update, we couldn't have the new penguin skins feeling lonely in a two chef huddle- that would be pretty ice-olating. The Arctic Fox is our latest furry friend addition, helping you chef up some great dishes and chipping in to think outside the fox..... we mean box!

[h3]🌨️ Which icy new skin will you be using in AYCE?[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/ae14fe6d05cec39568954d6f818e3d5ff2033dda.png[/img]

This Winter Chef Update also brings bug fixes to the World Food Festival Update and throughout All You Can Eat. Please find the patch notes for this update below!

[b][u][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][/u][/b]
[h3]New Chef & Skins[/h3]
[list][*] 1 new Chef added – Penguin Chef
[*] 2 new Alternate Skins added – Macaroni Penguin Skin and Arctic Fox Skin[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list][*] Improvements to d-pad functionality during gameplay.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Ever Peckish Chef and the Unbread Chef were not retained when updating to the World Food Festival Update.
[*] Fixed an issue with the Swedish Chef’s silhouette.
[*] Fixed issues with the location of the emote wheel in certain throne room scenes.[/list]
[h3]Assist Mode & Accessibility[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where text size in the main menu would not adjust after changing assist mode settings.
[*] Fixed an issue causing the pause menu to lose functionality when using the ‘Skip Level’ option in throne rooms.
[*] General improvements to level skip feature in pause menu.
[*] General improvements to the level skip feature in online multiplayer games.
[*] General improvements and fixes to the results screen after level skipping.
[*] General improvements to the functionality of the accessibility options.[/list]
[h3]World Food Festival[/h3]
[list][*] Score requirements for 3 player and 4 player online sessions in level 3-2 in the World Food Festival Campaign have been altered.
[*] Fixed an issue where the results screen would not display after finishing certain World Food Festivals levels.
[*] Fixed issues with level skipping in the World Food Festival Campaign.
[*] Fixed issues with the red ramp activation button next to level 3-2 in the World Food Festival Campaign.
[*] Fixed an issue where ingredients used for the delivery box completion could be instead used as a dish. 
[*] General physics and collision improvements in the World Food Festival campaign.
[*] General fixes to the delivery person mechanic in World Food Festival Campaign.
[*] Updated the level preview images to better represent levels in the World Food Festival Campaign.
[*] Cooked Onion will now show correctly when plated with a Sausage in level 2-2 of the World Food Festival Campaign.
[*] Fixed an issue where debug text appears in World Food Festival Campaign save slots.[/list]
More information and patch notes for other platforms can be found here: 👉 bit.ly/OC-Winter-Update

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/fa866d491ebf697eb380fb5b6349f7d5ec4b7ffc.gif[/img]

The new skins are perfect for playing through the icy levels of Overcooked! 1's Campaign and all the snowy DLC's found in All You Can Eat's Extra Trimmings Menu such as Winter Wonderland or Festive Seasoning!

You can also enjoy a tasty [b]50% OFF Overcooked! All You Can Eat[/b] until 20th February 2023!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/ab2048393717166e6d23e1839a03ad181c4535de.gif[/img]
[b]If you haven't played it already... 

[/b]
Overcooked! All You Can Eat is the ultimate Overcooked experience! Play over 200 kitchens with over 80 chefs, and with Assist Mode and cross-platform support, this is our most accessible Overcooked game! Players of all ages and abilities can enjoy co-op cooking on Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and Steam.

notes.title: Overcooked! All You Can Eat l Missing Chefs Workaround
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Chefs! 👨‍🍳👩‍🍳👋[/h3]

As some players are aware, there is currently a bug in Overcooked! All You Can Eat which hides the Ever-Peckish Chef and the Unbread Chef which you unlock by completing Overcooked! 1 and Overcooked 2! retrospectively.

Today we are happy to showcase a workaround to fix this in Overcooked! All You Can Eat! 

[h2]Missing Chefs Workaround! 🍔[/h2]

[previewyoutube=lhaw8R6sIS4;full][/previewyoutube]
Or Check out the Workaround Here 👉 https://bit.ly/ChefWorkaround

We want to apologise for any inconvenience this bug has caused. We hope that this walkthrough video helps all players of Overcooked! All You Can Eat. We are happy players can have...

[h3]...a Full Chef Menu Again! 😋[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/a8a2212a450139175ab8a8e2f6c5c6af37fc8cd4.png[/img]

Our team working on Overcooked! All You Can Eat are looking into the bug, we will hopefully have a fix for this soon. In the meantime, we hope this is a short-term fix to the issue!

That's all for today Chefs! 👋

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1243830/discussions/1/]In the meantime, if you notice any other issues with the game, please do get in touch via our Report a Problem section, here on Steam![/url]

notes.title: Overcooked! All You Can Eat : World Food Festival Update OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/82f703e8505b50a769f29df9465a42b273a7e9fd.jpg[/img]

[h2]Sip Sip, Hooray! It’s World Food Update Day![/h2]
Chefs! We hope you’re hungry – we’re serving up a hot and tasty new update for Overcooked! All You Can Eat! 

View the tasty trailer here: [previewyoutube=yER22yLFA40;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]World Food Festival [/b]
Get ready to embark on a completely new culinary adventure, complete with new chefs and new recipes! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/4a840554f7489820e66eebe2f94efc7e31768abf.gif[/img]

With 3 new biomes and 10 new levels, you’re going to have to use all your culinary skill and wit to keep all your customers satiated and happy! Be ready to dice and slice – you’ll have to also cater via a delivery bag! Deliver the correct ingredients, and a delivery person will arrive to pick it up which will clear the top. 

[h3]New Chefs
[/h3]
We're excited to announce new chefs are entering the fray! Globe, Fox and 1 alternate Goldfish skin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/85c8b8d56dd213462e785f6ddc49270877fc9564.gif[/img]

[h3]New Recipes
[/h3]
What would Overcooked be, without some absolutely scrumptious recipes? Try your hand at serving up some delicious bobotie and curry!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/6ef9654e31c8ccaf371928acfd84bdc6b50f6c76.gif[/img]

[h3]Order Up!
[/h3]
We're excited to announce a new mechanic! Occasionally, you may find that a serving point is blocked by a delivery bag. Place the raw ingredient that is requested, and a delivery person will arrive to pick it up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/609462fc21691bc8ea6d5a57fdfdf6dfa617ed59.gif[/img]

[h3]Accessibility Additions
[/h3]
This tasty update is chock-full of improvements regarding accessibility including level skipping, the ability to turn off fires, reduce flashing/camera shake, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/f0e3e82cafd7fe4c38cea2d5982c670def471ca3.gif[/img]

As a reminder, please find the patch notes for this hot update below!

[h2]Patch Notes
[/h2]
General:

New 10 level DLC campaign and Chefs.

Visit 3 Biomes, Baked Bazaar, Metro Mash and Pepper Plaza.
• 2 new chefs, Globe, Fox and 1 alternate skin for the Globe chef, Goldfish.
• 2 new recipes:
   - Bobotie
   - Curry
• New game mechanic using the takeaway delivery bag.
• Chefs can now be asked to box meals instead of plating.

Additional Accessibility options

• Added a reduced camera shake toggle.
• Reduce flashing effect toggle.
• Addition of an Assist mode added to the world map which can be toggled on/off at any point regardless of save file, allowing the game to be modified to the player’s needs.
   - Level skipping
   - Increase order timer slider
   - Increase recipe timer slider
   - Increase recipe scores by a percentage.
   - Toggle order timers on/off.
   - Shorten the player respawn timer.
   - Reduce the number of recipes displayed.
   - Turn off fires started by burnt food.
• Player direction is clearer with an indicator displayed beneath the chefs.
• Players aligned countertop highlight is now more noticeable.
• Fonts – Fixed several Dyslexia font bugs.
• Added a ‘flashing images’ warning to the boot flow.
• Game and controller settings can now be changed in game.

Fixed some general localisation issues.

Fixed an issue with the Ghost chef’s VFX can appear incorrectly.

Fixed an issue of uneven line spacing in the menu settings.

[PC] Fixed an issue where the controller icons were not displayed correctly.

[b]If you haven't played it already... 
[/b]
Overcooked! All You Can Eat is the ultimate Overcooked experience! Play over 200 kitchens with over 80 chefs, and with Assist Mode and cross-platform support, this is our most accessible Overcooked game! Players of all ages and abilities can enjoy co-op cooking on Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and Steam.

notes.title: Overcooked! All You Can Eat Online Update 1
notes.content:
[h2]Attention, Chef Pals! 👨‍🍳👩‍🍳👋[/h2]

We're happy to announce we are serving up a new update for Overcooked! All You Can Eat.

This tasty new update should address some of your concerns regarding unstable matchmaking and online play and includes some general and stability fixes. 

Here's what’s on the menu! 😋

[b][u]Patch Notes:[/u][/b]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash occurring when entering the Overcooked 1 Intro Apocalypse in a 4-player online session.
[*] Fix for empty slot names appearing as Slot 1, even in spaces Slot 2 & 3 for clients in an online session.
[*] Various minor bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]
[b]Stability[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where some players were unable to join an online game as the fourth player when their Team17 ID was over a certain character limit.
[*] Fixes for players receiving multiple errors when accessing Arcade areas of the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player is left in a blank lobby if they choose to retry matchmaking after all clients leave an arcade lobby, if they had selected a theme beforehand.
[*] Fixed an issue where the last remaining player in an online campaign session was left with a single chef - players are now given a second chef to continue playing on.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player was left in an empty arcade lobby if all clients left when matchmaking was completed.
[/list]
This patch will go live at [b]2PM GMT, Wednesday 2nd of March.[/b]

Now Chefs - get back in the kitchen and watch that pot, it's about to bubble over! 

If you’re new to Overcooked, why not [url=https://discord.gg/overcooked]join our official Discord[/url] to play and chat with other chefs, and learn useful tips and tricks! 🍽️

notes.title: Overcooked! All You Can Eat – Out Now On Steam!
notes.content:
[h3]Order up!

Overcooked! All You Can Eat is now available on Steam![/h3]

[previewyoutube=pvoe6FNxN2Q;full][/previewyoutube]

This new standalone game includes beautiful remasters of both original games and all their extra content, PLUS exclusive new levels and chefs AND a brand-new Assist Mode!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pLpBp0B.gif[/img]

For the first time in the series, you can play with your friends on other platforms with cross-platform online multiplayer for ALL levels!

[b][u]Overcooked! All You Can Eat Key Features:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Every mouthful:[/b] Includes every piece of Overcooked! and Overcooked! 2 content, remastered and available in 60 frames per second (30fps on Switch) in up to 4K resolution 
[*] [b]Multiple multiplayer courses:[/b] Levels originally from Overcooked! are playable with online multiplayer support for the very first time, with every Overcooked! All You Can Eat kitchen also featuring cross-play functionality!
[*] [b]Exclusive new kitchens & cooks:[/b] New levels, new chefs, and additional skins for every single chef – all exclusive to Overcooked! All You Can Eat
[*] [b]Trophies/Achievements:[/b] Brand new trophy and achievement sets for players to unlock
[*] [b]Cooking for all:[/b] Accessibility options and a new assist mode opens the game to more players than ever before.
[/list]

[i]Also, you can pet the dog…[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nY7Xz19.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/dbbf95c271edc517f7a3f0fa942218b674fd82a8.jpg[/img]

Alongside the 80+ playable chefs on offer, the original calamitous food connoisseur, Disney’s The Muppets’ Swedish Chef, is also [b]available to download for free until April 30th[/b] for all Overcooked! All You Can Eat players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/569ec710371ee32de42758b70f4707828abb25c1.jpg[/img]

Overcooked! All You Can Eat also includes new accessibility options and an Assist Mode, which adds the option to increase level times, boost scores awarded for each meal, lengthen recipe times, and the ability to turn off order expiration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39857623/37c2a3c5e0515b6ac407b198eba4be0373a21be1.jpg[/img]

The accessibility options include colour-blind friendly chef indicators, a scalable user interface and the ability to enable dyslexia friendly text.

[h2]Loyalty Discount:[/h2]
Owners of Overcooked or Overcooked 2 on Steam will be able to get a 15% discount on Overcooked! All You Can Eat until April 11th!

[h2]Launch Day Stream:[/h2]
We’ll be live on the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/team17ltd]Team17 Twitch channel[/url] at 8PM GMT / 1PM PDT / 4PM EDT and we’ll have 10 Steam keys to giveaway!

[h2]Want to chat?[/h2]
[url=https://discord.gg/overcooked]Join the official Overcooked Discord server![/url]

tags.feature: - Every mouthful: Includes every piece of Overcooked! and Overcooked! 2 content, remastered and available in 60 frames per second in up to 4K resolution

- Multiple multiplayer courses: Levels originally from Overcooked! are playable with online multiplayer support for the very first time, with every Overcooked! All You Can Eat kitchen also featuring cross-play functionality in a post-launch update
- Exclusive new kitchens & cooks: New levels, new chefs, and additional skins for every single chef – all exclusive to Overcooked! All You Can Eat
- Trophies/Achievements: Brand new trophy and achievement sets for players to unlock
- Cooking for all: Accessibility options and a new assist mode opens the game to more players than ever before
Not only will you get three new and exclusive chefs, you can also choose from the entire back catalogue of over 80 calamitous chefs, each enjoying at least one brand-new alternate skin variant.
PLUS, for a limited time only, The Muppets’ Swedish Chef is available to download for free for all Overcooked! All You Can Eat players.

Overcooked! All You Can Eat also includes new accessibility options and an assist mode, which adds the option to increase level times; boost scores awarded for each meal; lengthen recipe times, and the ability to turn off order expiration.
The accessibility options include colour-blind friendly chef indicators, a scalable user interface and the ability to enable dyslexia friendly text.
